name: add-comment
about: A comment on the run's item: links and mentions sanitized a second time, the footer, and the hidden name of what was applied.

items.body:
Looked at it, @someone.

See [the log](https://evil.example/x), ftp://evil.example/y and https://docs.rs/serde.

name: add-comment-rerun
about: A re-run of the job: the guard pages through the item's comments, finds the name the first attempt posted on the second page and leaves the comment out.

name: add-comment-limits
